summary: Re-certification of A1+P3 server-side private/uninsured 30-min evening-window guard, plus A2-A9 regression. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_private_window_guard.py with 12 targeted tests covering all 10 request cases (a-k). All 12 pass. Re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_regression_iter42.py: 22 passed, 2 skipped (pharmacy must_change_password + no unregistered directory-only record in preview — known non-regressions). Preview-only; IZAO/PIN 3040 untouched; no cleanup run. Code path verified: server.py internal_private_offer explicitly checks avail_mod.is_valid_private_time(body.time) → 400 BEFORE conflict check (→409); _create_private_appointment (used by /accept-requested and /portal /accept) also raises 400 for invalid window before running private_conflict (which itself now also returns PRIVATE_TIME_ERROR for defense-in-depth). OHIP /api/availability/slots returns normal 11:30-16:30 daytime slot list — unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: availability.private_conflict now correctly enforces PRIVATE_TIME_ERROR window BEFORE past/closure/vacation/blocked/break/double-book checks — good ordering.

Double-layer defense in server.py (explicit is_valid_private_time() check before private_conflict()) is intentional but redundant now that private_conflict enforces the window. Consider dropping the duplicate is_valid_private_time gate in internal_private_offer / _create_private_appointment to keep single source of truth — cosmetic.

PRIVATE_TIME_ERROR from private_conflict is currently mapped to 409 in _create_private_appointment fall-through path (private_conflict returns the error string which is raised as 409). Because the explicit 400 gate runs first this never surfaces as 409 today; if the duplicate 400 gate is removed later, remember to differentiate 400 window vs 409 conflict inside the fall-through mapping.
server.py is 4,137 lines — refactor advice from iter42 still applies.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 new window-guard + 22/22 regression, 2 skipped known preview state)

test_credentials: Provided creds all valid; pharmacy 1670dufferin still must_change_password (documented, not a regression).
